metadata.title: लोहरदगा निंगनी इतवार बाज़ार | Lohardaga Nigni Tribal Market | Jharkhand Adivasi Bazaar
metadata.description: Lohardaga is a tribal district in Jharkhand. Oraon is the largest tribe in this area. In tribal regions, weekly markets are the busiest places as people from nearby tribal villages reach there with forest produce and agricultural products.
